Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing local governments to restrict or prohibit smoking in public places.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing local governments to restrict orprohibit smoking in public places; amending RCW 70.160.080; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that among theimportant duties of local communities is protecting the public healthof its citizens and promoting the safety of its work force. To ensure the ability of local communities to do so, thelegislature finds and reaffirms the authority of cities, towns, andcounties to enact ordinances exercising local control and expressingindividual community values in the conduct of business and publichealth protection within their jurisdictions, including restricting orprohibiting smoking in locations where members of the public congregateand work.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.160.080 and 1985 c 236 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city, town, or county may restrict or prohibit smoking inpublic places situated within its jurisdiction, including but not p. 1 SB 5876limited to restaurants, skating rinks, and bowling alleys, regardlessof whether such restrictions or prohibitions are more restrictive thanthose imposed by state law. (2) Local fire departments or fire districts and local healthdepartments may adopt regulations as required to implement thischapter.
